evidence_sentence: If the allocation is successful, it rounds up the size to the nearest allocation granularity and initializes the memory to zero before returning the pointer to the memory object.
rationale: The fixed implementation alone computes the secure-DDR allocation granularity and zeroes ROUNDUP(size, granularity) bytes. The vulnerable implementation zeroes only size bytes and performs no rounding. This sentence therefore describes the patch-specific behavior and would reveal the fix.
rewritten_docstring: The function checks if the configuration for paged user TA is enabled. If it is, it calls `mobj_paged_alloc` to allocate the requested size. If not, it allocates memory using `mobj_mm_alloc` with specific parameters. If the allocation is successful, it initializes the allocated memory to zero before returning the pointer to the memory object.
